name: CoinPaprika API (free tier)
summary: Keyless crypto market data: coin list, tickers, global stats, exchanges, markets and a price converter.
description: Free tier of the CoinPaprika API at api.coinpaprika.com/v1 with prices, market cap, volume, percent changes and all-time highs for thousands of coins, exchange listings and markets per coin, global market statistics and a price converter. Historical OHLCV beyond the last day and higher limits need a paid key on a separate host.

auth.notes: The free plan on api.coinpaprika.com needs no key. A paid key goes in the Authorization header (raw key, no Bearer prefix) against api-pro.coinpaprika.com.

rate_limit.summary: Free plan: 20,000 calls per month; global cap of 10 requests per second per IP (docs). Responses carry ratelimit-limit/-remaining/-reset headers; 429 or 402 when exceeded.

endpoints.summary: All coins with rank and type
Global market cap, volume and bitcoin dominance

license.name: Free plan terms (not re-confirmed); redistribution requires the Enterprise plan per the FAQ

coverage.temporal: Current data; free OHLCV history limited

agent_notes: Coin ids look like btc-bitcoin (symbol-name); find them with /coins or /search/. Prices are volume-weighted averages across tracked markets, not one exchange's quote. The /tickers call without limit returns thousands of coins, so pass limit or use /tickers/{id}.
caveats: Historical OHLCV before the last day returned HTTP 402 (plan restriction) on the free host.
/search needs the trailing slash (/search/); without it the server answers 301.
The docs say commercial use is allowed inside the customer's company on paid plans and redistribution only on Enterprise; free-plan terms were not re-confirmed.
No OpenAPI document was found at the obvious URLs.

verification.notes: Example executed keyless: 200, ratelimit-limit 20000 seen. /coins, /global, /exchanges, /price-converter, /coins/{id}/markets and ohlcv/latest also 200.
